title: VERY lightweight, a bit flimsy
text: VERY lightweight, a bit flimsy. Unfortunately they are SO light weight they look cheap, and won't stand an item upright for long in any kind of a breeze.  But reasonable for the price, and if you have ONLY one card and it's an indoor event they'd probably work.
